**Counting:** Initialize four counting arrays `cnt[0..3]` in shared memory.
**Local Prefix Sum:** Perform a parallel optimized prefix sum (scan) on the four counting combinations simultaneously in shared memory.
**Shuffle:** Reorder elements in shared memory so that elements with the same radix digit are clustered together in sorted order.
- Permute the elements from the shared memory shuffle buffer to their calculated global positions in the output array.
- **Non-coalesced Scattering:** Standard radix sort scatters elements to global memory based on individual indices, causing uncoalesced writes.
- **Floating Point Mapping:** Floating point numbers must be mapped to integers to preserve order.
- **Order Checking:** The order check is performed at the start of each pass.
- **Time Complexity:** $O(N \cdot \lceil 32/2 \rceil) = O(16N)$, where $N$ is the number of elements.
